title: Topological interface states and nonlinear thermoelectric performance in armchair graphene nanoribbon heterostructures
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4680-4693
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09657J, Paper
Open Access

David M. T. Kuo
We investigate the emergence and topological nature of interface states in N-AGNR/(N − 2)-AGNR/N-AGNR heterostructure segments, focusing on their relation to the end states of the constituent armchair graphene nanoribbon segments.
